notes.capital_gains_distributions_cumulative/d: The statement only reports a single lump-sum 'Ganancias/Pérdidas Netas por Inversión' figure ($2,040.00 for the period) - it's not broken out into capital gains vs. dividends vs. interest, so these three fields are genuinely not derivable from this document.
notes.document_type: The schema's document_type enum is Brokerage/Mutual Fund/Stock Statement, none of which is a literal match for an 'IRA' statement. 'Brokerage Statement' is used as the closest fit since the issuer is a brokerage (Harbor Brokerage Services).
notes.contribution_dates/distribution_dates: Printed as MM/DD/YYYY ('03/10/2025', '06/15/2025', '11/20/2025'); normalized to ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) here, consistent with every other date field in this schema.
